title: Who's signing in?
enter: Sign in with your Linux account.
recent: Accounts recently used in this browser
footnote: Accounts recently used in this browser

err.wrong: Wrong username or password, or this account can't sign in here. Check Caps Lock and try again.

root.before: Root login is disabled on this server. Sign in with your own user and use sudo, or enable root with

err.rate: Too many failed attempts from this address. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
err.rateMinutes: Too many failed attempts from this address. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
err.forbidden: This account isn't allowed to sign in. Ask an administrator for access.
err.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
err.busy: The server is busy checking another sign-in. Try again in a moment.

key.not_a_key: This is not a private key. Choose the private key file (for example id_ed25519), not a .pub file.
key.public_key_given: That is a public key. Choose the private key instead: the file with the same name but without .pub.
key.unsupported_format: This key format is not supported. Export it in OpenSSH format (in PuTTYgen: Conversions, Export OpenSSH key) and choose that file.
key.passphrase_required: This key is protected by a passphrase. Type it to continue.
key.bad_passphrase: That passphrase does not open this key.
key.unsupported_key_type: This key type is not supported. Use an Ed25519, ECDSA or RSA key of at least 2048 bits.
key.unsupported_cipher: This key is encrypted with a method the browser cannot read. Re-encrypt a copy with: ssh-keygen -p -Z aes256-ctr -f <key file>
key.corrupt_key: This key file looks damaged or incomplete. Copy it again from where you saved it.
key.crypto_unavailable: This browser cannot sign in with a key on this page. Open LinuxAdmin over https, or from localhost.
key.key_refused: This key is not allowed for this account. It must be listed in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on this server.
key.challenge_invalid: The sign-in took too long or was already used. Try again.
key.ssh_keys_disabled: Signing in with an SSH key is turned off on this server. Use your password.
key.root_disabled: Root login is disabled on this server. Sign in with your own user and use sudo.
key.dev_mode_user: This server runs in development mode and only accepts the user that started it.
key.host_not_allowed: This server does not answer to the address in your browser. Use the address it is configured for (web.allowed_origins).
key.rate_limited: Too many failed attempts from this address. {wait}
key.busy: The server is busy checking another sign-in. Try again in a moment.
key.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
key.server_error: The server could not finish the sign-in. Try again, or use your password.

useKey: Sign in with an SSH key

key.note: The key stays in this browser. LinuxAdmin sends a one-time signature, never the key.
key.waitLater: Wait a few minutes before trying again.
